title: Invoked GRAP stage (rules-as-data)
description: Which stage a CAQM ORDER has invoked, together with the verbatim sentence that invoked it. This is NOT computed from an AQI reading: an order can invoke a stage pre-emptively on a forecast, or decline to. The implied stage is derived separately from stage_bands. When the two disagree, Aadesh says so rather than choosing. The citation is mandatory because this single field decides whether any obligation in the corpus applies at all.

stage.description: Stage ordinal as stated in the order. No maximum is encoded: which stages exist is declared by the corpus, not by this schema or by application code.

source_doc.description: doc_id of the order in sources/manifest.json. The same key every other citation uses, so verification can find it without a special case.

quote.description: VERBATIM text from that page stating the stage is invoked. `make verify` re-checks it like any other citation.

invoked_at.description: ISO-8601 instant the order took effect, as stated in the order, not as observed by a clock.

note.description: Optional editorial note. Never the legal basis for anything; the quote is.
